notes: Adds a Manager/Admin Safety Calendar under Reports. It combines training renewal dates, controlled-document review dates, monthly PPE checks, First Aid checks, custom checklist due dates and contractor/PTW start/finish dates in one month view. Calendar items use red/amber/green status, include type/person/status filters, a mobile-friendly month grid and agenda, and each event has a direct Go there button. Role-aware Help gains a direct Safety Calendar entry. No database migration is required. Includes all v2.10.42 Toolbox Talk suggestions and prior fixes.
